description: An npm workspace whose member manifest and root lockfile nest arrays 300 levels deep, beyond json.max-depth (256), and whose ignored pnpm-workspace.yaml nests flow sequences beyond the YAML depth limit. Each file is reported and not analyzed, inspection still completes, and the Next.js member falls back to its declared range (D-068, D-071, D-075, D-076). The member manifest naming next is created at test time (Q-014).
